lines.text_en: Excuse me, where is the station?
accepted: Excuse me, where is the station?

lines.text_en: The station? It is not far. Go straight and turn left.
lines.translation_ru: Вокзал? Это недалеко. Идите прямо и поверните налево.

lines.text_en: Sorry, can you repeat that slowly?
accepted: Sorry, can you repeat that slowly?

lines.text_en: Sure. Go straight. Turn left at the bank. The station is next to the café.
lines.translation_ru: Конечно. Идите прямо. Поверните налево у банка. Вокзал рядом с кафе.

lines.text_en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
accepted: Is there a pharmacy near here?

lines.text_en: Yes, there is one on Main Street, next to the bank.
lines.translation_ru: Да, есть одна на Мейн-стрит, рядом с банком.

lines.text_en: And where can I find an ATM?
lines.translation_ru: А где я могу найти банкомат?
accepted: And where can I find an ATM?
Where can I find an ATM?

lines.text_en: There is an ATM at the corner, in front of the hotel.
No, it is five minutes on foot.
